<tool_call>
<function=generate_email>
<parameter=content>
Subject: Re: Freelance Project Contract Questions

Hi Eliana,

Thank you for reviewing the contract. I appreciate you bringing these points up, and I am happy to address your questions.

Regarding the payment terms, I understand your preference for a net-30 structure. While our standard policy is net-60, we can certainly discuss adjusting this to net-30 for this specific project to accommodate your workflow.

As for the non-compete clause, I agree that it is important for the terms to be equitable. Let’s schedule a brief call to discuss potential adjustments that would make the clause more reasonable while still protecting our mutual interests.

Please let me know what time works best for you to connect.

Best regards,

Ms. Adams
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
